caption: the french beach-stunt sandbox - ramps, jumps and slow-motion replays on the sand.
about: Beach stunt racer (2001) is lankhor's stunt sandbox: drive beach buggies across sand maps stitched with ramps, hit the jumps, and watch the replay camera do its slow-motion lap. The stunt-scoring loop predates the open-world stunt genre by years, which makes this small french production a genuine early entry in the lineage.
The windows build is off sale, carried by archive routes.
